answer: Reaching the shale of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The reef lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the anchor is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing.
